senses.en: an open area near farm buildings

example.en: Chickens wandered freely in the farmyard.
example.zh: 鸡群在农家庭院里自由漫步。

senses.en: very foolish and not carefully thought out

example.en: They dismissed the plan as a harebrained scheme.
example.zh: 他们认为这个计划是个轻率的馊主意。

senses.en: the activity or profession of writing dictionaries

example.en: She has spent thirty years in lexicography.
example.zh: 她从事词典编纂工作已有三十年。

senses.en: historical records of events, often arranged year by year

example.en: The discovery earned a place in the annals of science.
example.zh: 这项发现被载入了科学史册。

senses.en: a person whose religion is Judaism or whose ancestors were Jewish

example.en: Jews around the world celebrate Hanukkah in December.
example.zh: 世界各地的犹太人在十二月庆祝光明节。

senses.en: a mark left by the pattern on a finger, used to identify a person

example.en: The police found fingerprints at the crime scene.
example.zh: 警方在案发现场发现了指纹。

senses.en: to take someone's fingerprints

example.en: The police fingerprinted the suspect at the station.
example.zh: 警方在警局采集了嫌疑人的指纹。

senses.en: the act of forcing someone to do something against their will

example.en: He signed the contract only under coercion.
example.zh: 他只是在胁迫下才签了合同。

senses.en: very strong and sincere feeling or enthusiasm

example.en: She spoke about the project with great fervour.
example.zh: 她满怀热情地谈起这个项目。

senses.en: Using, producing, or powered by electricity.

example.en: The factory installed new electric motors last year.
example.zh: 这家工厂去年安装了新的电动机。

senses.en: Full of excitement or tension, as if charged with energy.
senses.zh: 令人激动的；紧张刺激的

example.en: The atmosphere in the stadium was electric before the final whistle.
example.zh: 终场哨响前，体育场里的气氛非常热烈。

senses.en: the state of being physically weak

example.en: The illness left him with a general weakness in his legs.
example.zh: 这场病使他的双腿普遍无力。

senses.en: a fault or weak point

example.en: The report pointed out several weaknesses in the design.
example.zh: 报告指出了设计中的几个弱点。

senses.en: a strong liking for something

example.en: She has a weakness for dark chocolate.
example.zh: 她特别偏爱黑巧克力。

senses.en: as a result of this; for this reason

example.en: The road is closed, hence the detour.
example.zh: 道路封闭，因此需要绕行。

senses.en: from this time; from now

example.en: The project will be completed two years hence.
example.zh: 该项目将在两年后完成。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged; needing careful handling

example.en: Handle the delicate glass vase carefully.
example.zh: 小心轻放这只易碎的玻璃花瓶。

senses.en: fine, subtle, and pleasing in detail or quality

example.en: The pastry had a delicate flavor.
example.zh: 这种糕点味道清淡细腻。

senses.en: requiring careful or tactful treatment

example.en: This is a delicate situation, so choose your words wisely.
example.zh: 这是个微妙的局面，说话要谨慎。

senses.en: probably going to happen or be true
senses.zh: 很可能的；预计会发生的

example.en: A storm is likely this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午很可能有暴风雨。

senses.en: probably

example.en: She will likely call us tonight.
example.zh: 她今晚很可能会给我们打电话。

senses.en: suitable or promising for a purpose

example.en: She is a likely candidate for the job.
example.zh: 她是这份工作的合适人选。

senses.en: A pure substance made of only one type of atom.

example.en: Oxygen is an element, while water is a compound.
example.zh: 氧是元素，而水是化合物。

senses.en: One of the parts that make up a whole.

example.en: Trust is an important element of a good friendship.
example.zh: 信任是良好友谊的一个重要要素。

senses.en: A small amount of a quality or feeling.

example.en: There is an element of truth in her argument.
example.zh: 她的论点中有一定道理。

senses.en: a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together

example.en: A swarm of bees flew past the window.
example.zh: 一大群蜜蜂飞过窗户。

senses.en: a large moving crowd of people

example.en: A swarm of reporters gathered outside the building.
example.zh: 一大群记者聚集在大楼外。

senses.en: to move or gather together in large numbers

example.en: Fans swarmed onto the field after the game.
example.zh: 比赛结束后，球迷们蜂拥进入球场。

senses.en: to find out or make certain of a fact by investigation or calculation

example.en: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the accident.
example.zh: 警方正在设法查明事故的原因。

senses.en: a container with a handle used for holding and pouring liquids

example.en: She poured some milk from the jug into her coffee.
example.zh: 她从壶里倒了些牛奶加进咖啡。

senses.en: (slang) a prison or jail

example.en: He spent two years in the jug for robbery.
example.zh: 他因抢劫坐了两年牢。

senses.en: (dated, of a hare) to stew meat slowly in a covered jug or pot

example.en: Jugged hare is a traditional English dish.
example.zh: 罐炖野兔是一道传统英国菜。

senses.en: to feel or express sympathy for someone

example.en: I sympathize with anyone who has lost a pet.
example.zh: 我同情任何失去宠物的人。

senses.en: to understand and share someone's feelings or opinions

example.en: She sympathized with the workers' demands for better conditions.
example.zh: 她理解工人们改善条件的要求。

senses.en: treating all sides equally; fair and without bias

example.en: The judge remained impartial throughout the trial.
example.zh: 法官在整个审判过程中保持公正。

senses.en: a short well-known saying that expresses a common truth or piece of advice

example.en: The proverb "practice makes perfect" encourages people to keep trying.
example.zh: “熟能生巧”这句谚语鼓励人们不断尝试。

senses.en: a small model of a person, especially a baby, used as a toy

example.en: The little girl dressed her doll in a pink dress.
example.zh: 小女孩给她的洋娃娃穿上了一条粉色的裙子。

senses.en: (informal, dated) a term of address for a woman, often implying she is attractive
senses.zh: （非正式，旧时用法）美人；宝贝儿

example.en: He called her a sweet doll when she brought him coffee.
example.zh: 她给他端来咖啡时，他称她为甜甜的小美人。

senses.en: a family name and male given name
senses.zh: 戴维斯（姓氏，也用作男子名）

example.en: Mr. Davis works at the local bank.
example.zh: 戴维斯先生在当地银行工作。

senses.en: the lowest range of sound in music; a male voice of the lowest range

example.en: The bass provides the foundation of the song.
example.zh: 低音是这首歌的基础。

senses.en: having a low range of sound or voice

example.en: He turned up the bass setting on the speakers.
example.zh: 他调高了音箱的低音设置。

senses.en: a freshwater or sea food fish prized for eating and sport

example.en: We grilled a fresh sea bass for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐烤了一条新鲜的海鲈鱼。

senses.en: full of life, energy, or excitement

example.en: They had an animated discussion about the movie.
example.zh: 他们就这部电影展开了热烈的讨论。

senses.en: made to look as if it is moving, as in cartoons

example.en: My kids love watching animated films.
example.zh: 我的孩子们喜欢看动画电影。

senses.en: present or spreading everywhere in a place or thing
senses.zh: 普遍的；弥漫的；无处不在的

example.en: Smartphones have had a pervasive influence on daily life.
example.zh: 智能手机对日常生活有着无处不在的影响。

senses.en: dealing with real, important issues rather than superficial details

example.en: The two sides held substantive talks about trade policy.
example.zh: 双方就贸易政策举行了实质性会谈。

senses.en: relating to essential rights and duties rather than procedure (law)

example.en: Substantive law defines rights, while procedural law defines how they are enforced.
example.zh: 实体法规定权利，程序法规定权利如何执行。

senses.en: a word or group of words functioning as a noun (grammar)

example.en: In the phrase 'the rich,' 'rich' functions as a substantive.
example.zh: 在短语 'the rich' 中，'rich' 用作名词。

senses.en: relating to tension or stretching

example.en: Engineers tested the tensile strength of the steel cable.
example.zh: 工程师测试了钢缆的抗拉强度。

senses.en: capable of being stretched or drawn out

example.en: Copper is a highly tensile metal that can be drawn into thin wires.
example.zh: 铜是一种延展性很高的金属，可以拉成细丝。

senses.en: a method or manner of doing something

example.en: There are many ways to cook rice.
example.zh: 做米饭有很多种方法。

senses.en: a road, route, or path for traveling

example.en: We took the shortest way to the station.
example.zh: 我们走了去车站最短的路。

senses.en: a direction or distance

example.en: He walked a long way before resting.
example.zh: 他走了很远的路才休息。

senses.en: (informal, especially US) very far or very much; completely

example.en: The price is way too high.
example.zh: 价格实在太高了。

senses.en: the number 6; one more than five

example.en: There are six chairs around the table.
example.zh: 桌子周围有六把椅子。

senses.en: the digit or symbol 6; a playing card showing six pips

example.en: She rolled a six on the dice.
example.zh: 她掷骰子掷出了六点。

senses.en: by means of this statement or document (formal)

example.en: I hereby declare the meeting closed.
example.zh: 我特此宣布会议结束。

senses.en: a decoration added to make something more attractive

example.en: Flowers were used as an adornment for the wedding table.
example.zh: 鲜花被用来装饰婚宴餐桌。

senses.en: speaking smoothly and confidently but in a way that seems insincere or shallow

example.en: The salesman's glib answers failed to convince the customers.
example.zh: 推销员油滑的回答没能让顾客信服。

senses.en: of or suitable for a king or queen; magnificent

example.en: She entered the hall with a regal bearing.
example.zh: 她仪态庄重地走进大厅。

senses.en: a place where ships are built or repaired

example.en: The old shipyard still builds fishing boats.
example.zh: 这座老船厂仍在建造渔船。

senses.en: a thin narrow strip of wood or metal

example.en: The fence is made of wooden slats.
example.zh: 这栅栏是用木条板做的。

senses.en: to provide or fasten with slats

example.en: They slatted the sides of the crate.
example.zh: 他们给板条箱的侧面装上板条。

senses.en: a member of the Religious Society of Friends, a Christian group known for pacifism and simplicity

example.en: Many Quakers were active in the campaign against slavery.
example.zh: 许多贵格会教徒积极参与废奴运动。

senses.en: a sexually transmitted bacterial disease that develops in stages and can be present at birth

example.en: Syphilis is treatable with antibiotics when detected early.
example.zh: 梅毒若及早发现可用抗生素治疗。

senses.en: to make something by putting parts together

example.en: They plan to build a new school here.
example.zh: 他们计划在这里建一所新学校。

senses.en: to develop or increase something over time

example.en: Reading helps children build confidence.
example.zh: 阅读有助于孩子建立自信。

senses.en: the shape and size of someone's body

example.en: The runner has a strong, lean build.
example.zh: 这位跑步者体格强壮而精瘦。

senses.en: a version of software made available for testing or use

example.en: The latest build fixes several bugs.
example.zh: 最新构建版本修复了几个错误。

senses.en: an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light and air
senses.zh: 墙上装有玻璃、可透光通风的开口；窗户

example.en: She opened the window to let in some fresh air.
example.zh: 她打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

senses.en: a rectangular area on a computer screen that shows a program or document
senses.zh: 电脑屏幕上显示程序或文档的矩形区域；窗口

example.en: Close the window when you finish reading the file.
example.zh: 读完文件后请关闭窗口。

senses.en: a period of time available for something, or a chance to act
senses.zh: 可做某事的一段时间；时机

example.en: The store offers a two-hour delivery window.
example.zh: 这家商店提供两小时的送货时间窗口。

senses.en: the ability to face danger or fear without letting it stop you

example.en: She showed great courage during the rescue.
example.zh: 她在救援中表现出极大的勇气。

senses.en: the strength to do something difficult or face disapproval

example.en: He had the courage to admit his mistake.
example.zh: 他有勇气承认自己的错误。

senses.en: used as the object when the subject is a male person and is the same person
senses.zh: 他自己（作宾语，指与主语同一男性）

example.en: He taught himself to play the guitar.
example.zh: 他自学弹吉他。

senses.en: used to emphasize a male subject
senses.zh: 他本人，他亲自（用于强调男性主语）

example.en: The manager himself answered the phone.
example.zh: 经理亲自接了电话。

senses.en: used after “by” to mean alone or without help
senses.zh: （用于 by 后）独自，靠自己

example.en: He finished the project by himself.
example.zh: 他独自完成了这个项目。

senses.en: a large empty space; a feeling of emptiness or loss

example.en: She felt a void in her life after he left.
example.zh: 他离开后，她感到生活中一片空虚。

senses.en: having no legal force; invalid

example.en: The contract was declared void.
example.zh: 该合同被宣布无效。

senses.en: to make invalid; to cancel (a contract, check, etc.)

example.en: They voided the agreement last week.
example.zh: 他们上周取消了该协议。

senses.en: completely empty of something (often followed by 'of')

example.en: The room was void of furniture.
example.zh: 房间里没有家具。

senses.en: to cover a surface with concrete, stones, or similar material
senses.zh: 铺（路面等）；用石板、混凝土等铺盖

example.en: Workers paved the road with asphalt last month.
example.zh: 工人们上个月用沥青铺了这条路。

senses.en: to prepare or make something possible for a future development
senses.zh: 为……铺平道路；为……创造条件

example.en: The agreement paved the way for closer cooperation.
example.zh: 这项协议为更紧密的合作铺平了道路。

senses.en: always; in every case without exception

example.en: He invariably arrives ten minutes early for meetings.
example.zh: 他开会总是提前十分钟到。

senses.en: the quantity of motion of an object; in classical mechanics, its mass multiplied by its velocity
senses.zh: （物理）动量（经典力学中等于质量与速度的乘积）

example.en: The truck gained momentum as it rolled down the hill.
example.zh: 卡车滑下山坡时动量越来越大。

senses.en: the force that keeps a process moving or growing steadily

example.en: The campaign is gaining momentum among young voters.
example.zh: 这场运动在年轻选民中势头渐旺。

senses.en: the respect and importance someone earns through achievement

example.en: The award greatly enhanced her stature in the scientific community.
example.zh: 这项奖项大大提升了她在科学界的声望。

senses.en: a person's natural height

example.en: He was small in stature but strong.
example.zh: 他身材矮小但很强壮。

senses.en: relating to the body

example.en: Regular exercise improves bodily health.
example.zh: 经常锻炼能改善身体健康。

senses.en: as a whole; in one piece; in person

example.en: He picked the box up and carried it bodily into the room.
example.zh: 他把箱子整个搬进了房间。

senses.en: a very small village or settlement

example.en: They live in a tiny hamlet in the mountains.
example.zh: 他们住在山区的一个小村庄里。

senses.en: the prince in Shakespeare's tragedy of the same name
senses.zh: 哈姆雷特（莎士比亚悲剧中的王子）

example.en: Hamlet debates whether to avenge his father's death.
example.zh: 哈姆雷特纠结是否要为父亲的死复仇。

senses.en: a tropical bird with a hooked beak, often brightly colored, that can imitate sounds

example.en: The parrot learned to say a few words.
example.zh: 这只鹦鹉学会了说几个词。

senses.en: to repeat someone's words without understanding them

example.en: He just parroted his boss's opinions.
example.zh: 他只是鹦鹉学舌般地重复老板的意见。

senses.en: feeling happy that something unpleasant has ended or did not happen
senses.zh: 感到宽慰的；松了口气的

example.en: She was relieved to hear that her flight was only delayed.
example.zh: 听说航班只是延误，她松了一口气。

senses.en: the quality of staying faithful or unchanged over time

example.en: His constancy to his friends never wavered.
example.zh: 他对朋友的忠诚从未动摇。

senses.en: a person whose back is curved or hunched

example.en: The old man walked slowly, bent like a hunchback.
example.zh: 老人走得很慢，弯得像个驼背。

senses.en: an abnormal backward curvature of the spine

example.en: Severe scoliosis can result in a hunchback.
example.zh: 严重的脊柱侧凸可导致驼背。

senses.en: not showing feelings or personal connection; cold and distant

example.en: The hospital felt cold and impersonal to her.
example.zh: 在她看来，这家医院冷漠而缺乏人情味。

senses.en: not related to any particular person; objective

example.en: Keep the report impersonal and focus on the facts.
example.zh: 报告要保持客观，只关注事实。

senses.en: (grammar, of a verb or pronoun) not referring to a person

example.en: 'It' is used impersonally in the sentence 'It is raining.'
example.zh: 在句子 It is raining 中，it 用作非人称代词。

senses.en: showing sharp insight and understanding

example.en: She asked a penetrating question that no one could answer.
example.zh: 她提了一个敏锐的问题，没人能回答。

senses.en: able to pierce or pass deeply into something; sharp and carrying far

example.en: A penetrating cold wind swept across the field.
example.zh: 刺骨的寒风扫过田野。

senses.en: the sweet liquid inside flowers that insects collect

example.en: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
example.zh: 蜜蜂采集花蜜来酿蜜。

senses.en: a sweet fruit drink

example.en: She drank a glass of peach nectar with breakfast.
example.zh: 她早餐喝了一杯桃子果汁。

senses.en: relating to the belief that human dignity, reason, and well-being are central
senses.zh: 人文主义的，人本主义的

example.en: She takes a humanistic approach to teaching, focusing on each student's needs.
example.zh: 她采用以学生为本的教学方式，关注每个学生的需求。

senses.en: relating to Renaissance humanism

example.en: The painting reflects humanistic ideas from the Renaissance.
example.zh: 这幅画反映了文艺复兴时期的人文主义思想。

senses.en: a metal tool with a sharp flat edge used for cutting or shaping wood or stone

example.en: He shaped the stone with a hammer and chisel.
example.zh: 他用锤子和凿子修整石块。

senses.en: to cut or shape something with a chisel

example.en: She chiselled her name into the rock.
example.zh: 她把自己的名字刻在岩石上。

senses.en: to cheat or swindle someone, especially of money

example.en: They chiselled customers out of hundreds of dollars.
example.zh: 他们骗取了顾客数百美元。
